description: Get the distilled user profile: profile sections, top preferences by confidence (max 15), and the 5 most recent lessons. Optional userId/sessionId/projectId scope the auto-projected memories; without them only GLOBAL memories are included.

projectId.description: Include GLOBAL plus this project's PROJECT-scoped memories

sessionId.description: Include GLOBAL plus this session's SESSION-scoped memories

userId.description: Include GLOBAL plus this user's USER-scoped memories
